title: Spicy Syrian Millet Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish from Syria, made with spicy zesty millet and served with crispy fried onions.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the millet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the zesty pilaf spice mix and stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with crispy fried onions.
